newsitem.title: UK: Police investigate reports of N.Irish blast.
newsitem.headline: Police investigate reports of N.Irish blast.

text.p: Northern Ireland police said on Thursday they were investigating reports of an explosion in north Belfast.
A police spokesman said a British forces patrol was in the area at the time. Security sources said first indications were that any injuries were slight.
A police spokesman said that officers were investigating "first reports of a small explosion in the Ardoyne area of Belfast. A security patrol was in the area at the time."
The spokesman said that an area around Etna Drive, a terraced street, was later cordoned off as a precaution.

Ardoyne is a largely Catholic district whose residents want Northern Ireland merged into an all-Ireland state under Dublin rule. It borders a Protestant neighbourhood where support for continue British rule is strong.
No group claimed responsibility for the explosion.
